SK Gaming is a German esports organization. Founded in 1997 under the name "Schroet Kommando" in Oberhausen, Germany, it has since then grown into one of the largest and most well-known eSports organizations in the world, and they are primarily known for their hugely successful Counter-Strike and Counter-Strike: Global Offensive rosters.

Trivia

[edit]
  • SK Gaming was a founding member of the, now defunct, G7 Teams. [87]
  • Placed 1st in almost all nine of their 2003 events (only placing 3rd at both ClikArena and Electronic Sports World Cup)
  • SK Gaming won 42 LAN matches in a row from the 13th of July 2003 till the 20th of December 2003, winning 6 tournaments in a row.
  • Hold the record for most Counter-Strike majors won with 6 titles: CPL Summer 2002, CPL Summer 2003, World Cyber Games 2003, CPL Winter 2003, CPL Winter 2005 and Electronic Sports World Cup 2011.
  • SK Gaming is the first and only team to win two ESL One: Cologne events and win them back-to-back - Defeating Team Liquid 2-0 in 2016 and Cloud9 3-0 in 2017.
  • In 2017, the team won 8 out of 9 grand finals on LAN. The only event they lost a grand final to was DreamHack Masters Las Vegas 2017 where they lost to Virtus.pro 1-2.
